introHtml: Richardson beanies are built for durability and comfort, making them a top choice for corporate winter gear. With a classic knit construction and consistent sizing, they take embroidery and screen printing cleanly for a polished look. Safety managers and HR directors often choose Richardson for uniform programs because the fit stays reliable wash after wash. Whether you are outfitting a crew for a cold-weather event or stocking a company store, these beanies keep your logo visible and your team warm.
